entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` TEXT NOT NULL, `searchText` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lastEditedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isPinned` INTEGER NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_notes_isPinned_lastEditedAt
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_notes_isPinned_lastEditedAt` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`isPinned`, `lastEditedAt`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `searchText` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`notes`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `notes_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`searchText`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `notes_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `searchText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`searchText`); END
